FolDeX: A Physical-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects Manipulation

real-robot benchmark long-horizon manipulation deformable objects data reuse garment folding

简要说明：FolDeX是一个大规模的真实机器人基准，专注于长周期可变形物体操作（以衣物折叠为核心），提供了超过2000小时的异构数据，涵盖多种任务和机器人形态，旨在研究异构数据重用并提供标准化评估平台。

TLDR: FolDeX is a large-scale real-robot benchmark for long-horizon deformable object manipulation, centered on garment folding, with over 2,000 hours of heterogeneous data across many tasks and embodiments, designed to study data reuse and provide a standardized evaluation platform.

Abstract: Embodied AI, including vision-language-action and world-action models, must operate reliably in the physical world. Yet methods that perform well in simulation can degrade substantially on real robots, especially in long-horizon deformable-object manipulation, where policies must track changing states and execute reliable multi-stage bimanual interactions. Existing real-robot benchmarks mainly focus on short-horizon rigid-object tasks and offer limited coverage of long-horizon deformable manipulation. We introduce FolDeX, a physical-world benchmark built entirely from real-robot data, with garment folding as its primary task. Since real-robot data collection is costly, FolDeX studies how heterogeneous physical experience can be reused efficiently. The benchmark is organized around four research axes: leveraging human intervention and recovery data collected during deployment; transferring data across tasks, including across garment categories and from rigid to deformable-object manipulation; reusing data across scenes with changes in lighting, background, and layout; and transferring data across robotic embodiments. FolDeX provides 2,000+ hours of real-robot data spanning 20+ tasks and 10+ embodiments. We also establish a fair real-robot evaluation platform for externally submitted policies, with standardized tasks, held-out physical objects, controlled initializations, and a unified execution protocol. The platform is publicly accessible at https://ai.midea.com/#/fold-challenge. We hope FolDeX will serve as a unified testbed for heterogeneous real-robot data reuse and reliable long-horizon deformable manipulation.

摘要（中文）：具身人工智能，包括视觉-语言-动作模型及世界-动作模型，必须在物理世界中可靠运行。然而，在仿真环境中表现优异的方法在真实机器人上性能可能大幅下降，特别是在长时域可变形物体操作任务中——这类任务要求策略追踪不断变化的状态，并执行可靠的多阶段双臂交互。现有真实机器人基准测试主要聚焦于短时域刚体任务，对长时域可变形操作场景的覆盖有限。本文提出FolDeX，一个完全基于真实机器人数据构建的物理世界基准测试，以衣物折叠作为核心任务。鉴于真实机器人数据采集成本高昂，FolDeX致力于研究异构物理经验的高效复用方式。该基准测试围绕四个研究轴心组织：利用部署过程中采集的人类干预与恢复数据；跨任务（包括跨越衣物类别及从刚体到可变形物体操作）的数据迁移；在光照、背景和布局变化的场景间复用数据；以及跨机器人形态的数据迁移。FolDeX提供了超过2000小时的真实机器人数据，涵盖20余项任务和10余种机器人形态。我们还为外部提交的策略建立了公平的真实机器人评估平台，包含标准化任务、保留的物理物体、受控的初始化条件以及统一的执行协议。该平台可通过 https://ai.midea.com/#/fold-challenge 公开访问。我们希望FolDeX能成为异构真实机器人数据复用及可靠长时域可变形操作任务的统一测试平台。

Authors: Chenhuan Liu, Yi Xu, Feng Wu, Hanyang Wang, Wenxiao Kuai, Weihao Ding, Shan Wang, Yang Liu, Shuyong Gao, Wenqiang Zhang

Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots VLA

semantic action interface zero-shot robot control VLM agent embodied harness GUI manipulation interface

简要说明：Show-Harness 是一个语义接口，通过暴露离散动作单元使 VLM 能够零样本控制机器人，支持闭源和微调的开源 VLM，无需针对具体形态的预训练。

TLDR: Show-Harness is a semantic interface that enables VLMs to control robots zero-shot by exposing discrete action units, supporting both closed-source and fine-tuned open-source VLMs without embodiment-specific pretraining.

Abstract: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit broad intelligence about the world, yet translating this intelligence into robot control remains challenging. We present Show-Harness, an Embodied Harness that enables VLMs to "play" robots through a compact semantic interface linking intent to action. Show-Harness exposes discrete semantic action units that VLMs can naturally reason over, while embodiment-specific interpreters deterministically ground them into local robot actions, keeping the VLM directly responsible for fine-grained physical decisions. Through the same interface, Show-Harness demonstrates the feasibility of (1) directly unlocking closed-source frontier VLMs for zero-shot robot control, and (2) adapting small-scale open-source VLMs for low-cost deployment with just a few GPU-hours of fine-tuning. We further develop GUMI (GUI Manipulation Interface), which extends the same semantic action space to GUI-based demonstration collection, allowing humans and agents to "play" robots across embodiments without specialized teleoperation hardware. Extensive experiments show that Show-Harness-equipped VLM agents generalize robustly across tasks, embodiments, and environments, outperforming representative agentic and VLA paradigms. These results suggest that the right interface can unlock substantial embodied capability from foundation VLMs, without requiring additional model capacity or costly embodiment-specific pretraining.

摘要（中文）：基础视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出对世界的广泛认知，但将这些认知转化为机器人控制仍具挑战。我们提出Show-Harness——一种具身控制器，通过连接意图与动作的紧凑语义接口，使VLM能够“操控”机器人。Show-Harness暴露了VLM可自然推理的离散语义动作单元，而具身特定解释器则将这些单元确定性地映射为局部机器人动作，使VLM直接负责细粒度的物理决策。通过同一接口，Show-Harness证明了以下可行性：（1）直接解锁闭源前沿VLM实现零样本机器人控制；（2）仅需数GPU小时的微调即可适配小型开源VLM用于低成本部署。我们进一步开发了GUMI（图形用户界面操控接口），将相同语义动作空间扩展至基于GUI的演示采集，使人机与智能体无需专用遥操作硬件即可跨具身形态“操控”机器人。大量实验表明，配备Show-Harness的VLM智能体在任务、具身形态及环境维度均展现出稳健泛化能力，性能优于具代表性的智能体范式和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）范式。这些结果表明，恰当的接口能够在不增加模型容量或昂贵具身预训练的情况下，充分释放基础VLM的具身能力。

Authors: Yanzhe Chen, Zechen Bai, Zhijun Cao, Wenzheng Zeng, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Qiming Huang, Mike Zheng Shou

DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation Manipulation

latent world model cross-view conditioning 7-DoF control visual planning robot manipulation

简要说明：DUET-DINO 提出了一种同时跨视角潜世界模型，利用静态侧视和夹爪相机观测来预测未来视觉表征，从而在机器人操作中实现对完整 7 自由度动作空间的零样本目标条件规划与控制。

TLDR: DUET-DINO introduces a simultaneous cross-view latent world model that leverages static side- and gripper-camera observations to predict future visual representations, enabling zero-shot goal-conditioned planning and control over the full 7-DoF action space in robot manipulation.

Abstract: Action-conditioned latent world models predict future visual representations, enabling zero-shot goal-conditioned robot planning and control. However, their predictions for fine-grained spatial and rotational actions are unreliable for full 7-DoF end-effector control. To address this gap, we introduce DUET-DINO, a simultaneous cross-view latent world model that jointly learns action-conditioned predictions from static side- and wrist-camera observations through cross-view conditioning. By exploiting complementary global scene and gripper-centric information, DUET-DINO enables latent planning over the full 7-DoF action space. Across spatially diverse reach, orientation-intensive angled-reach, and multi-goal grasp-and-lift tasks, DUET-DINO consistently outperforms single-view and independent dual-view baselines, achieving 92% success on reach, 72.5% on angled-reach, and 60.0% on lift tasks. DUET-DINO is trained from scratch on DROID and RoboArena datasets and generalizes robustly under visual distribution shifts. We further show that while V-JEPA 2 wrist-view predictions underestimate visual dynamics induced by fine-grained actions, DINOv3 predictions better capture action-conditioned scene changes, leading to stronger downstream planning. The code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced. Project page: https://utn-air.github.io/DUET-DINO

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于动作条件的潜在世界模型可预测未来视觉表征，从而实现零样本目标条件机器人规划与控制。然而，在完整的7自由度末端执行器控制中，该类模型对精细空间与旋转动作的预测存在不可靠性。为解决这一问题，我们提出DUET-DINO——一种同步跨视角潜在世界模型，通过跨视角条件化机制从静态侧视与腕部摄像头观测中联合学习动作条件预测。通过利用互补的全局场景及机械爪中心信息，DUET-DINO能够在完整7自由度动作空间上实现潜在规划。在空间多样化到达、方向密集倾斜到达及多目标抓取-提升任务中，DUET-DINO持续优于单视角与独立双视角基线模型，在到达、倾斜到达及提升任务中分别达到92%、72.5%和60.0%的成功率。该模型基于DROID与RoboArena数据集从头训练，并在视觉分布偏移下展现出稳健的泛化能力。进一步研究表明，尽管V-JEPA 2腕部视角预测低估了精细动作引发的视觉动态，但DINOv3的预测能更好捕捉动作条件场景变化，从而增强下游规划性能。代码与模型检查点将开源。项目页面：https://utn-air.github.io/DUET-DINO

Authors: Nisarga Nilavadi, Ralf Römer, Moritz Reuss, Michael Krawez, Tobias Jülg, Angela P. Schoellig, Rudolf Lioutikov, Wolfram Burgard

Frequency-Conditioned Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

frequency-conditioned flow matching vision-language-action models DCT frequency coordinates robot action generation LIBERO

简要说明：FreqFM 提出频率条件流匹配用于 VLA 模型，在 DCT 频率域中显式建模动作轨迹的非均匀能量分布，并在多个基准和真实机器人任务上取得一致性能提升。

TLDR: FreqFM introduces frequency-conditioned flow matching for VLA models, explicitly modeling the non-uniform energy distribution of action trajectories in the DCT frequency domain and achieving consistent performance gains on multiple benchmarks and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Robot actions are temporally correlated trajectories whose frequency components encode motion at different scales with highly non-uniform energy distributions. Yet Flow Matching--based vision-language-action (VLA) models typically generate actions in temporal coordinates, without explicitly modeling or systematically leveraging this frequency heterogeneity. We introduce \emph{FreqFM}, a frequency-conditioned Flow Matching framework for VLA models. It raises action frequency from an implicit trajectory property to an explicit conditioning dimension that spans the entire generation pipeline. Concretely, in DCT frequency coordinates, FreqFM constructs a spectrum-matched source distribution, adaptively balances the objective across frequencies, and constrains per-frequency guidance residuals using the corresponding reference transport scales. FreqFM integrates into existing Flow Matching action experts without changing the VLA backbone. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLA-Arena, FreqFM consistently improves performance, including a 9.3-point gain on LIBERO-Plus, and further demonstrates its effectiveness on six real-robot tasks.

摘要（中文）：机器人动作是时间上相关的轨迹，其频率分量以高度非均匀的能量分布编码了不同尺度的运动。然而，基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常直接在时间坐标中生成动作，并未显式建模或系统性利用这一频率异质性。我们提出FreqFM——一种面向VLA模型的频率条件化流匹配框架。该框架将动作频率从隐式的轨迹属性提升为覆盖整个生成流程的显式条件维度。具体而言，在DCT频率坐标下，FreqFM构建了与频谱匹配的源分布，自适应平衡不同频率上的目标函数，并利用对应的参考传输尺度约束各频率的引导残差。FreqFM可直接集成至现有流匹配动作专家模块，无需改动VLA主干网络。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及VLA-Arena数据集上，FreqFM持续提升性能，其中在LIBERO-Plus上取得9.3个百分点的增益，并在六项真实机器人任务中进一步验证了其有效性。

Authors: Haochen Niu, Shengye Dong, Hao Liu, Peiwen Lin, Wang Chuang

Data-Driven Risk Fields for Safer End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving risk field BEV feature relative risk supervision safety

简要说明：DRiF 通过成对相对风险标签学习共享的 BEV 风险场，在端到端自动驾驶中无需手工设计的绝对分数即可改善碰撞指标。

TLDR: DRiF learns a shared BEV risk field from pairwise relative risk labels, improving collision metrics in end-to-end autonomous driving without handcrafted absolute scores.

Abstract: Safety is a fundamental requirement for autonomous driving, yet existing end-to-end driving models still lack explicit risk-aware learning capacities. Existing rule-based risk models provide interpretable safety priors, yet their absolute risk scores depend on handcrafted functions, coefficients, and thresholds. Learning-based risk representations reduce part of this manual design, but their supervision often relies on occupancy-derived labels or heuristic cost values, which may not capture ego-conditioned planning risk. In this paper, we propose DRiF, a data-driven risk-field framework for safer end-to-end autonomous driving. DRiF learns a shared BEV feature with static map segmentation, dynamic risk prediction, and vehicle planning. For dynamic risk learning, DRiF converts rule-based safety priors into pairwise risk labels, and trains the risk field to preserve relative risk ordering instead of regressing handcrafted absolute scores. Experiments on Bench2Drive show that DRiF achieves competitive overall performance, with consistent improvements in driving score, success rate, and collision-related metrics. These results establish relative risk supervision as an effective way to connect explicit safety structure with end-to-end planning. The data and code will be publicly available.

摘要（中文）：安全是自动驾驶的基本要求，然而现有端到端驾驶模型仍缺乏显式的风险感知学习能力。现有基于规则的风险模型虽可提供可解释的安全先验，但其绝对风险分数依赖于手工设计的函数、系数与阈值。基于学习的风险表征虽减少了部分人工设计，但其监督信号往往依赖占据网格衍生标签或启发式成本值，这些方法可能无法捕捉以自车为中心的规划风险。本文提出DRiF——一种面向更安全端到端自动驾驶的数据驱动风险场框架。DRiF通过静态地图分割、动态风险预测与车辆规划共享鸟瞰图特征进行联合学习。在动态风险学习方面，DRiF将基于规则的安全先验转化为成对风险标签，并训练风险场保留相对风险排序而非回归手工设计的绝对分数。Bench2Drive实验表明，DRiF在驾驶分数、成功率及碰撞相关指标上持续提升，取得了具有竞争力的整体性能。这些结果验证了相对风险监督作为连接显式安全结构与端到端规划的有效途径。相关数据与代码将公开。

Authors: Yuanxin Tian, Zhiyuan Liu, Jinhao Li, Liangfan Zhu, Shuai Wang, Heye Huang, Qingwen Meng, Fang Zhang, Liuzhu Tong, Zhenhua Xu, Wenhao Yu, Jianqiang Wang

Deformable Object Manipulation under Partial Observability via Real-Time Full-Shape Estimation Manipulation

deformable object manipulation full-shape estimation receding-horizon optimal control conditional recurrent VAE real-time robot control

简要说明：提出了cRVAE，一种轻量级循环变分自编码器，能从部分角点观测中实时估计可变形物体的完整形状，从而在机器人上实现模型预测控制。

TLDR: Proposes cRVAE, a lightweight recurrent VAE for real-time full-shape estimation of deformable objects from partial corner-node observations, enabling model-predictive control on a robot.

Abstract: Manipulating deformable objects (DOs) is challenging due to their high-dimensional state space, underactuated dynamics, and partial observability. In this paper, we propose cRVAE, a lightweight conditional recurrent variational autoencoder that estimates the full DO state from only partial corner-node observations during inference. The resulting model is used as the forward model in a receding-horizon optimal control framework for obstacle-aware collaborative DO manipulation. In simulation on rope and fabric, cRVAE estimates the full DO state from the available corner-node measurements alone, matching the accuracy of a parameter-identified XPBD model. At inference it uses no physical parameters as model inputs and performs no online parameter identification. It also runs approximately 350 times faster on the rope and over 1500 times faster on the fabric per forward pass, keeping horizon-based planning within the 100 ms control budget where XPBD exceeds it already at short horizons. Full-shape estimation from corner sensing at in-loop speed is what makes the model deployable on hardware, which we demonstrate on a Unitree Go2 robot.

摘要（中文）：操控可变形物体（DO）因其高维状态空间、欠驱动动力学特性及部分可观测性而极具挑战性。本文提出cRVAE——一种轻量级条件循环变分自编码器，可在推理阶段仅通过部分角节点观测值估计完整DO状态。该模型被用作滚动时域最优控制框架中的前向模型，实现障碍感知下的协作式DO操控。在绳索与织物的仿真实验中，cRVAE仅凭借可用角节点测量值即可估计完整DO状态，其精度与参数辨识后的XPBD模型相当。推理过程中，该模型无需输入物理参数，亦无需在线参数辨识。其单次前向传播速度在绳索模型上提升约350倍，在织物模型上提升超1500倍，使基于时域规划的决策可在100毫秒控制预算内完成（而XPBD模型即便在短时域下已超出该预算）。利用角点传感实现全形估计的在线运算速度，使该模型具备硬件部署能力——我们在宇树Go2机器人上验证了这一点。

Authors: Kosar Behnia, Ville Kyrki, Gokhan Alcan

Learning Terrain-Adaptive Humanoid Locomotion on Granular Terrain Locomotion

humanoid locomotion granular terrain resistive force theory teacher-student RL terrain adaptation

简要说明：基于物理的颗粒接触模型（3D RFT）用于强化学习训练，实现了适应地形的双足人形运动策略，并成功迁移至真实颗粒地形，首次实现了敏捷人形机器人在颗粒地形上的运动。

TLDR: A physics-grounded granular contact model (3D RFT) is used for RL training, enabling a terrain-adaptive humanoid locomotion policy that transfers to real-world granular terrains, achieving the first agile humanoid locomotion on such surfaces.

Abstract: Humanoid locomotion on granular terrain remains a significant challenge due to its complex foot-terrain interaction dynamics that are difficult to model. Existing approaches either ignore granular contact dynamics or incorporate simplified normal force models with heuristic tangential components. In this work, we present a physics-grounded granular contact model based on three-dimensional resistive force theory (3D RFT) and efficiently simulate granular terrain for reinforcement learning (RL) training. Unlike traditional rigid contact models and simplified granular contact models with ad-hoc heuristics, our contact solver produces physically accurate granular intrusion dynamics without resorting to heuristics. It captures realistic penetration and tangential drag during training, enabling the policy to learn behaviors that transfer reliably to real-world granular terrain where rigid contact models fail. To adapt to varying terrain conditions, we train a terrain-adaptive locomotion controller via teacher-student RL, using a variational autoencoder to encode terrain information into a compact latent representation. Simulation studies using material point method (MPM) with NVIDIA Newton demonstrate that our method generalizes to unseen granular terrains, achieves a significantly higher success rate than baselines, and demonstrates zero-shot terrain identification and adaptation. We further validate our approach through extensive hardware experiments across diverse real-world granular terrains including basalt, dry sand, and beach sand. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of agile humanoid locomotion on real-world granular terrain. Project page: https://humanoid-gm-locomotion.github.io/HUMANOID-GM/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在颗粒地形上的类人机器人运动仍是一项重大挑战，原因在于其脚与地形的复杂交互动力学难以建模。现有方法要么忽略颗粒接触动力学，要么采用带有启发式切向分量的简化法向力模型。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于物理的颗粒接触模型，该模型基于三维抗力理论（3D RFT），并能够高效模拟颗粒地形以用于强化学习（RL）训练。与传统的刚性接触模型以及采用特定启发式方法的简化颗粒接触模型不同，我们的接触求解器能够在不依赖启发式假设的情况下，生成物理上准确的颗粒侵入动力学。它在训练过程中能够捕捉真实的穿透和切向拖曳行为，从而使策略学会在刚性接触模型失效的真实颗粒地形中可靠迁移的行为。为适应不同地形条件，我们通过教师-学生强化学习训练了一个地形自适应运动控制器，并使用变分自编码器将地形信息编码为紧凑的潜变量表示。基于NVIDIA Newton的材质点法（MPM）仿真研究表明，我们的方法能够泛化到未见过的颗粒地形，相比基线方法实现了显著更高的成功率，并表现出零样本地形识别与适应能力。我们进一步通过在多种真实颗粒地形（包括玄武岩、干沙和海滩沙）上的广泛硬件实验验证了本方法的有效性。据我们所知，这是首次在真实颗粒地形上实现敏捷类人机器人运动的演示。项目页面：https://humanoid-gm-locomotion.github.io/HUMANOID-GM/

Authors: Junnosuke Kamohara, Feiyang Wu, Andy Ningan Zong, Daniel I. Goldman, Yashwanth Nakka, Seth Hutchinson, Ye Zhao

SwingBot: Learning Whole-Body Brachiation for Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid brachiation whole-body control privileged-state estimation biomimetic keyframes passive wrist hooks

简要说明：SwingBot提出了一种学习框架，使人形机器人能够利用被动腕钩实现连续全身摆荡运动，通过仿生关键帧和循环特权状态估计实现鲁棒的实物部署。

TLDR: SwingBot introduces a learning framework that enables humanoid robots to perform continuous whole-body brachiation using passive wrist hooks, leveraging biomimetic keyframes and recurrent privileged-state estimation for robust real-world deployment.

Abstract: Brachiation enables primates to move across overhead supports when ground paths are blocked, suggesting a complementary locomotion mode for robots operating in cluttered or hazardous environments. Bringing this capability to high-DoF humanoid robots is difficult because the controller must discover a long-horizon release-swing-capture sequence, coordinate alternating contacts with whole-body momentum, and act without reliable measurements of segment-relative displacement or hook-contact state. We present SwingBot, a learning framework for continuous humanoid brachiation with passive wrist hooks. SwingBot makes the task trainable by organizing learning around the structure of brachiation: biomimetic keyframes make rare release-swing-capture transitions reachable during early exploration, and recurrent privileged-state estimation provides compact position and contact latents for deployment. Hardware experiments demonstrate continuous bar traversal and robustness to payload, external disturbances and different bar spacings, showing that this formulation offers a practical route to whole-body robotic brachiation.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 臂行运动使灵长类动物在地面路径受阻时能够借助头顶支撑物移动，这为机器人在杂乱或危险环境中提供了一种互补的运动模式。将该能力赋予高自由度人形机器人颇具挑战性，因为控制器必须规划出包含"释放-摆动-抓握"的长时序动作序列、协调交替接触与全身动量，并在缺乏可靠的肢体相对位移或挂钩接触状态测量的条件下执行动作。我们提出SwingBot——一种使具备被动腕部挂钩的人形机器人实现连续臂行运动的学习框架。SwingBot通过围绕臂行运动结构组织学习过程来确保任务的可训练性：仿生关键帧使得"释放-摆动-抓握"这一罕见转换在早期探索阶段即可实现，而循环特权状态估计则为部署阶段提供了紧凑的位置与接触潜在表征。硬件实验表明，该方法能够实现连续横杆穿越，并对负载变化、外部扰动及不同横杆间距具有鲁棒性，验证了该方案为全身机器人臂行运动提供了一条可行路径。

Authors: Yujie Xiong, Peng Zhai, Taixian Hou, Quancheng Qian, Cunwang Liu, Kangmai Hu, Long Yang, Zhiyan Dong, Lihua Zhang

Frame-Coded Legged Locomotion over Noisy Terrain Locomotion

frame coding legged locomotion rough terrain erasure channel compliance

简要说明：本文将粗糙地形上的多足 locomotion 建模为带擦除的量化有限帧扩展，推导出模拟帧编码定理，建立了足式 locomotion 的基本极限理论。

TLDR: This paper frames legged locomotion over rough terrain as a quantized finite-frame expansion with erasures, deriving an analog frame-coding theorem that establishes a fundamental limit theory for legged locomotion.

Abstract: Open-loop multilegged locomotion over rough terrain has been interpreted as matter transport over a noisy channel: leg-ground interactions are discrete basic active contacts, terrain deletes or perturbs those contacts, and spatial redundancy concentrates the resulting thrust and arrival time. That construction is repetition-like because every module carries the same scalar locomotion task. It consequently provides neither a positive task rate nor a decoder that changes with the surviving contact set. Here we formulate locomotion instead as a quantized finite-frame expansion with erasures. A d-dimensional body-level command is mapped into N>d heterogeneous local contact commands. Rough terrain erases or corrupts frame coefficients, while a contact-gated compliant morphology physically realizes the weighted active-subframe decoder. For a linear-Gaussian model, mechanical equilibrium is exactly the posterior mean, tangent stiffness is posterior precision, and mechanical compliance is posterior covariance. Equal-norm Parseval frames are shown to be minimax optimal against one missing contact, two-contact robustness is governed by frame coherence, and a harmonic frame gives a directly realizable gait family. For independently surviving contacts of probability q, random Gaussian gait frames admit exact reconstruction at every analog dimension rate Rq. Residual contact noise yields an asymptotic per-mode amplification 1/(q-R) and a vanishing mechanical stiffness margin at the threshold. An information-locomotion inequality and an exact incremental-redundancy rule direct the next gait component toward the softest task-relevant unresolved mode. The resulting analog frame-coding theorem establishes a finite relative redundancy and converse as part of a fundamental limit theory of legged locomotion.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 粗糙地形上的开环多足运动已被解释为通过噪声信道进行的物质传输：腿-地相互作用是离散的基本主动接触，地形会删除或扰动这些接触，而空间冗余则聚焦由此产生的推力与到达时间。该构造具有类重复性，因为每个模块承担相同的标量运动任务。因此，它既不提供正任务速率，也不提供随幸存接触集变化的解码器。本文将运动重新表述为一种带有擦除的量化有限帧扩展。一个d维本体级指令被映射为N>d个异构局部接触指令。粗糙地形会擦除或破坏帧系数，而接触门控的柔性形态学则物理实现了加权主动子帧解码器。对于线性高斯模型，机械平衡恰好是后验均值，切向刚度是后验精度，而机械柔度是后验协方差。等范数帕瑟瓦尔帧被证明在对抗单一接触缺失时具有极小极大最优性，两接触鲁棒性由帧相干性支配，而谐波帧则提供了一组可直接实现的步态族。对于独立幸存接触概率为q的情况，随机高斯步态帧在每个模拟维度速率Rq时，任意指令的恢复是不可能的。残余接触噪声导致渐近每模放大倍数1/(q-R)，并在阈值处产生消失的机械刚度裕度。一条信息-运动不等式及精确增量冗余规则将下一步态分量引导至最软的任务相关未解析模。由此产生的模拟帧编码定理建立了有限相对冗余及其逆命题，作为腿式运动基本极限理论的一部分。

Authors: Lav R. Varshney

IMU-Centric Moving Horizon Estimation for Lateral Dynamics Estimation Across Vehicles and Grip Conditions AutonomousDriving

IMU-centric Moving Horizon Estimation lateral dynamics estimation lateral velocity autonomous racing

简要说明：本文提出了一种以IMU为中心的移动时域估计（MHE）框架，利用标准车载传感器精确估计车辆横向动力学（速度、加速度），并在有人驾驶跑车和自动驾驶开轮赛车上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an IMU-centric Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) framework for accurately estimating lateral vehicle dynamics (velocity, acceleration) using standard onboard sensors, validated on human-driven sports cars and an autonomous open-wheel race car.

Abstract: Accurate estimation of lateral vehicle dynamics near the adhesion limit is important for stability control and high-performance driving, but lateral velocity is rarely measured directly because sensors such as optical sensors are costly. This paper presents an inertial measurement unit (IMU)-centric Moving Horizon Estimation framework that reconstructs lateral velocity using standard onboard signals, without relying on exteroceptive odometry or detailed tire-parameter tuning. Experimental validation on human-driven sports cars and an autonomous open-wheel race car across tracks, maneuvers, and conditions demonstrates accurate and robust lateral velocity and lateral acceleration estimates. The proposed framework is available at https://github.com/Aseuffo/IMU-Centric-MHE

摘要（中文）：精准估计接近附着极限时的车辆横向动力学，对稳定性控制与高性能驾驶至关重要，但横向速度很少被直接测量，因为光学传感器等设备成本高昂。本文提出了一种以惯性测量单元为核心的移动时域估计框架，利用标准车载信号重建横向速度，无需依赖外部里程计或详细的轮胎参数调校。通过在不同赛道、驾驶操作及工况下，对有人驾驶跑车与自动驾驶方程式赛车的实验验证，该框架能够准确且鲁棒地估计横向速度与横向加速度。所提框架开源地址为：https://github.com/Aseuffo/IMU-Centric-MHE

Authors: Seuffo Akouan ha Ngoune, Alessandro Toschi, Paolo Burgio, Marko Bertogna

Assembling Two Parts in One Hand Manipulation

in-hand assembly reinforcement learning dexterous manipulation sim-to-real transfer finger coordination

简要说明：一个统一的强化学习框架，实现单只灵巧手内两个刚性部件的在手掌装配，通过基于功能的辅助奖励和人类参考姿态塑造手指级协调，在零样本模拟到现实迁移中表现出对遮挡的鲁棒性。

TLDR: A unified reinforcement learning framework for in-hand assembly of two rigid parts using a single dexterous hand, with finger-level coordination shaped by function-based auxiliary rewards and a human reference pose, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with robustness to occlusion.

Abstract: A hallmark of human dexterity is the cooperative use of fingers, where different fingers take on distinct yet coordinated roles to accomplish fine manipu- lation, such as capping a pen with the hand that holds it. We study this finger-level coordination through in-hand assembly: mating two rigid objects within a single dexterous hand, with no second arm and no fixture. We present a reinforcement learning formulation to solve this problem in a unified framework, which is driven by a goal relative pose between the two parts. Finger coordination is shaped by a function-based auxiliary reward and regularized toward a single human reference pose, while domain randomization and a fusion of historical proprioception and object observation confer robustness to occlusion-induced estimation noise. The same recipe solves three different assembly tasks (Bottle, Syringe, and Marker). Trained purely in simulation, the policies transfer zero-shot to hardware with a single camera, demonstrating robustness to state-estimation errors caused by oc- clusion. Our experiments also reveal that in-hand assembly places demands on hand morphology and can serve as a benchmark for modern robotic hand systems. Videos and code are available at https://ltbgbird.github.io/in-hand-assembly-page/.

摘要（中文）：人类灵巧性的一个标志是手指的协同使用，其中不同手指承担不同但协调的角色，以完成精细操作，例如在用握笔的手盖上笔帽。我们通过掌上装配研究这种手指层级的协调：在单只灵巧手内部完成两个刚性物体的配合，不借助第二只手臂或固定装置。我们提出了一种基于强化学习的方法，在统一框架内解决此问题，该方法由两个部件之间的目标相对位姿驱动。手指协调通过基于功能的辅助奖励进行塑造，并朝向单一人体参考姿态进行正则化，同时领域随机化以及历史本体感知与物体观测的融合赋予了对遮挡引起的估计噪声的鲁棒性。同一套方案解决了三种不同的装配任务（瓶子、注射器和记号笔）。策略完全在仿真中训练，能够零样本迁移至配备单个摄像头的硬件系统，展现出对遮挡造成的状态估计误差的鲁棒性。我们的实验还表明，掌上装配对手部形态提出了要求，并可作为现代机器人手部系统的基准。视频和代码可在 https://ltbgbird.github.io/in-hand-assembly-page/ 获取。

Authors: Liuao Pei, Tianyue Wu, Hui Zhang, Ping Luo, Jie Song

Grounding Generated Video Plans in Simulation Towards Versatile Dexterous Controllers Manipulation

hand-object interaction dexterous manipulation sim-to-real video generation tracking

简要说明：本文结合生成的手物体交互视频与基于仿真的接地技术，学习一个通用的灵巧控制器，在真实世界中实现多种抓取和操作。

TLDR: This paper combines generated hand-object interaction videos with simulation-based grounding to learn a versatile dexterous controller, enabling diverse grasps and manipulation in the real world.

Abstract: Generated hand-object interaction (HOI) videos provide a controllable way to propose manipulation motions. Simulation-based HOI tracking can translate such kinematic references into feasible low-level control, but its scalability is limited by the lack of reliable reference motions. We therefore combine generated videos with simulation-based HOI grounding: during training, generated videos provide diverse motion references for learning a multi-object, multi-trajectory HOI tracker, and at deployment, the video model produces motion plans that are executed by the learned tracker. In particular, we propose a method that enables scalable reference generation by HOI reconstruction with minimal manual intervention and successfully grounds more than 1,500 generated videos in simulation, achieving success rates over 25 percentage points higher than those of baselines during simulation-based training. In real-world closed-loop experiments, it achieves diverse grasps, including functional grasps, non-prehensile manipulation, and post-grasp object-pose tracking. Videos and code are available at https://boyuan-an.github.io/GALATEA/.

摘要（中文）：生成的手-物交互（HOI）视频提供了一种可控的方式来提出操作运动。基于仿真的HOI跟踪可将此类运动学参考转化为可行的底层控制，但其可扩展性受限于缺乏可靠的运动参考。为此，我们将生成视频与基于仿真的HOI接地相结合：在训练阶段，生成视频为学习多对象、多轨迹HOI跟踪器提供多样化的运动参考；在部署阶段，视频模型生成运动规划，并由学习到的跟踪器执行。具体而言，我们提出了一种方法，通过最小化人工干预的HOI重建实现可扩展的参考生成，并成功地将超过1500个生成视频在仿真中接地，在基于仿真的训练中实现了比基线方法高出25个百分点以上的成功率。在实际闭环实验中，该方法实现了多样化的抓取，包括功能性抓取、非抓握操作以及抓取后物体姿态跟踪。视频和代码见 https://boyuan-an.github.io/GALATEA/。

Authors: Tianyue Wu, Boyuan An, Shuqi Zhao, Heyu Guo, Wanli Xing, Yi Ma, Kaifeng Zhang, Ruihai Wu, Masayoshi Tomizuka

RoboDrop: Curating VLA Post-Training Data via Local Gradient Compatibility VLA

data curation gradient compatibility VLA post-training robot policy supervision auditing

简要说明：RoboDrop 是一个数据筛选框架，通过训练轨迹上的局部梯度兼容性检测并过滤 VLA 后训练数据中的不可靠监督，使真实机器人策略成功率从 35% 提升至 67.5%。

TLDR: RoboDrop is a data-curation framework that uses local gradient compatibility along the training trajectory to detect and filter unreliable supervision in VLA post-training datasets, improving downstream policy performance from 35% to 67.5% on real robots.

Abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) models acquire broad generalization through large-scale pretraining, yet adapting them to a new task and robot embodiment still requires post-training on newly collected data. Unlike pretraining, post-training targets task- and embodiment-specific adaptation, making it particularly sensitive to data quality. In practice, collected robot datasets often contain heterogeneous errors, including execution mistakes, sensor drift, and timestamp misalignment, which can impair post-training and policy performance. Manual inspection is costly, while existing data-cleaning methods are typically tailored to particular corruption types. To address these challenges, we introduce \textsc{RoboDrop}, a data-curation framework that audits supervision using local gradient compatibility measured along the training trajectory as a proxy for its effect on post-training performance. During a one-epoch warm-up run, RoboDrop scores each candidate sample online by comparing its gradient with those of task-semantic and visually matched validation samples. The resulting sample scores are aggregated at the episode level, and a simple automatic post-processing rule converts them into filtering decisions. We evaluate RoboDrop on controlled observation--action corruptions, naturally suboptimal demonstrations in simulation, and real-robot datasets containing non-expert collection errors. Across these settings, RoboDrop more accurately distinguishes unreliable demonstrations than prior methods, while post-training on the curated data consistently yields stronger downstream policies, with average real-robot rollout success rising from $35.0\%$ to $67.5\%$. These results establish training-trajectory-aware, context-conditioned supervision auditing as an effective approach to robust VLA post-training.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过大规模预训练获得广泛泛化能力，但在适配新任务和机器人本体时，仍需对新增采集数据进行后训练。与预训练不同，后训练聚焦于任务与本体特异性适配，因此对数据质量尤为敏感。实际采集的机器人数据集常包含异质性误差，包括执行错误、传感器漂移和时间戳错位，这些误差会损害后训练效果及策略性能。人工检查成本高昂，而现有数据清洗方法通常针对特定噪声类型定制。为解决这些挑战，我们提出\textsc{RoboDrop}——一种数据筛选框架，该框架利用沿训练轨迹测量的局部梯度兼容性作为代理指标，以评估监督信号对后训练性能的影响。在单轮预热运行中，RoboDrop通过在线比较每个候选样本的梯度与任务语义及视觉匹配的验证样本的梯度，为各样本评分。所得样本分在回合级聚合，并通过简单的自动后处理规则转化为筛选决策。我们在受控观测-动作噪声、仿真中的自然次优演示以及包含非专家采集错误的真实机器人数据集上评估了RoboDrop。实验表明，相较于现有方法，RoboDrop能更准确地区分不可靠演示，且基于筛选数据进行的后训练持续产生更强的下游策略，使真实机器人部署成功率从35.0%提升至67.5%。这些结果确立了结合训练轨迹感知与上下文条件的监督审计作为鲁棒VLA后训练的有效方法。

Authors: Runze Xu, Yuanfan Xu, Cuijie Xu, Shuang Dai, Yining Li, Yu Wang, Jincheng Yu

HaWMPO: Hallucination-Aware World Model-based Policy Optimization for Generalist Robot Policy VLA

hallucination-aware world model policy optimization generalist robot policy reinforcement learning VLA

简要说明：HaWMPO 提出了一种基于世界模型的策略优化方法，针对 VLA 模型中的长时预测幻觉问题，通过幻觉感知模型和 Reward-Soft 机制抑制不可靠的动作片段，在 LIBERO 和真实 G1 机器人上显著提升了成功率。

TLDR: HaWMPO introduces a world model-based policy optimization pipeline for VLA models that uses a hallucination-aware model to estimate prediction reliability, suppressing unreliable action chunks via a Reward-Soft mechanism and achieving significant performance improvements on LIBERO and real G1 robot tasks.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies have demonstrated strong generalization across robotic manipulation tasks, yet their success rates remain limited in com- plex long-horizon scenarios. Recent methods improve Visual-Language-Action (VLA) policies through online reinforcement learning on real robots, but such training relies on costly physical interactions, suffers from low sample efficiency, and may introduce hardware and safety risks. World models offer a promising alternative by enabling policy optimization with imagined rollouts. However, long-horizon rollouts generated by world models often suffer from prediction hal- lucinations, producing biased state transitions that can mislead policy learning. To address this issue, we propose Hallucination-aware World Model-based Pol- icy Optimization (HaWMPO), a closed-loop reinforcement learning pipeline for VLA policy post-training with world models. Specifically, HaWMPO introduces an action-conditioned hallucination-aware model to estimate the reliability of gen- erated image sequences, and incorporates hallucination scores into group relative policy optimization through a Reward-Soft mechanism, suppressing unreliable ac- tion chunks during training. On the LIBERO benchmark, HaWMPO achieves the best average success rate, with gains of 15.0% over the base model and 2.8% over the strongest baseline; real-world experiments on a G1 robot further validate its effectiveness, raising the average success rate on two manipulation tasks from 67.5% to 80.0%.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人策略已在多种机器人操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力，但在复杂的长时序场景中其成功率仍十分有限。近期方法通过在实际机器人上开展在线强化学习改进了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，然而此类训练依赖昂贵的物理交互，样本效率低，且可能引入硬件与安全风险。世界模型通过支持策略在想象推演中优化的方式提供了有潜力的替代方案，但世界模型生成的长时序推演常存在预测幻觉，产生有偏的状态转移，进而误导策略学习。针对该问题，我们提出基于幻觉感知世界模型的策略优化方法（HaWMPO），这是一种面向VLA策略后训练的世界模型闭环强化学习流水线。具体而言，HaWMPO引入了一种基于动作条件的幻觉感知模型来估计生成图像序列的可靠性，并通过奖励软机制将幻觉分数融入分组相对策略优化中，从而在训练过程中抑制不可靠的动作片段。在LIBERO基准上，HaWMPO取得了最佳平均成功率，相较基线模型提升15.0%，相较最强基准提升2.8%；G1机器人的实际场景实验进一步验证了其有效性，将两项操作任务的平均成功率从67.5%提升至80.0%。

Authors: Zengjue Chen, Peidong Liu, Jiawei Li, Qi Wang

Time-Frequency Geometric Cross-Attention for Chunked Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

time-frequency analysis geometric cross-attention action chunk VLA policies domain generalization

简要说明：提出了一个用于视觉-语言-动作策略的时频几何交叉注意力模块，该模块对多尺度运动结构和跨阶段几何关系进行建模，提升了策略性能和泛化能力。

TLDR: Proposes a time-frequency geometric cross-attention module for VLA policies that models multi-scale motion structure and cross-phase geometric relationships, improving policy performance and generalization.

Abstract: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies predict a whole chunk of actions: one to two seconds of coordinated motion emitted in a single forward pass. Yet an action chunk is essentially a short multivariate trajectory, but inside these models it is a sequence of generic per-timestep hidden tokens decoded by a linear head. This under-serves two motion structures. First, frequency: a chunk superimposes a smooth global trend and fine corrective motion across time scales, and a single token entangles them. Second, cross-phase geometry: motions of different phases (reach, contact, grasp adjustment, settling) unfold along very different, near-orthogonal directions in representation space, yet are tightly related for the task and arise across the time axis. Dot-product attention scores alignment by an inner product, so it favors aligned tokens and is least sensitive near orthogonality, leaving such relationships for the network to recover through a detour. We introduce Time-Frequency Geometric Cross-Attention (TFGCA), a drop-in module repairing both blind spots. TFGCA uses a per-dimension learnable stationary wavelet transform to decompose the action chunk into time-frequency tokens, and each time token retrieves information from them via a cross-attention that fuses the dot product (similarity) with the wedge-product magnitude (sensitive to near-orthogonality) through a learnable weight. A zero-initialized residual reproduces the base behavior at initialization, so it can be dropped onto a pretrained VLA and fine-tuned jointly. Relative to the same-source base, TFGCA improves in-distribution LIBERO by +1.5 on average, the OOD LIBERO-Plus by +6.3, the randomized average under RoboTwin domain randomization by +28.5, and the overall success rate on three real-robot AgiBot A2 tasks by +11.67 points, with larger gains out of distribution.

摘要（中文）：现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能预测一整段动作：即在单次前向传播中生成的持续1到2秒的协调运动。然而，动作片段本质上是一段短程多变量轨迹，但在这些模型中，它却被表示为一系列由线性解码头解码的通用逐时间步隐藏令牌。这种方式未能充分服务于两种运动结构。第一，频率特性：一个动作片段叠加了跨时间尺度的平滑全局趋势与精细矫正运动，而单个令牌将它们纠缠在一起。第二，跨阶段几何特性：不同阶段（如伸达、接触、抓取调整、稳定）的动作在表示空间中沿截然不同且近乎正交的方向展开，但这些阶段为完成任务而紧密相关，并贯穿时间轴。点积注意力分数通过内积进行对齐，因此偏好对齐的令牌，在正交性附近最不敏感，迫使网络通过迂回方式恢复此类关系。 我们提出了时频几何交叉注意力（TFGCA），这是一种即插即用模块，用于修复上述两个盲区。TFGCA利用逐维度可学习平稳小波变换将动作片段分解为时频令牌，每个时间令牌通过交叉注意力从这些令牌中检索信息，该注意力机制通过可学习权重融合了点积（相似性）与楔积模长（对近正交性敏感）。零初始化的残差连接可在初始化时复现基础行为，因此该模块可直接嵌入预训练的VLA模型并进行联合微调。与同源基准相比，TFGCA在分布内LIBERO数据集上平均提升+1.5，在分布外LIBERO-Plus上提升+6.3，在RoboTwin域随机化下的随机化平均性能提升+28.5，在三个真实机器人AgiBot A2任务上的总体成功率达提升+11.67个百分点，且分布外场景增益更为显著。

Authors: Shengye Dong, Haochen Niu, Hao Liu, Peiwen Lin, Chuang Wang, Shanmin Pang

ViBe: Visual Behavior Adaptation for Perceptive Humanoid Whole-Body Control HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid whole-body control pre-trained visual encoders low-rank adapters zero-shot sim-to-real perceptive control

简要说明：ViBe通过低秩适配器嫁接预训练视觉编码器，将运动跟踪器改造为感知型人形控制器，在行走、跑酷、操作和躲避球任务中实现零样本仿真到真实迁移。

TLDR: ViBe adapts motion trackers into perceptive humanoid controllers by grafting pre-trained visual encoders via low-rank adapters, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across walking, parkour, manipulation, and dodgeball tasks.

Abstract: Motion tracking provides a scalable recipe for humanoid whole-body control. By design, the resulting trackers lack exteroceptive feedback hence reacting to the environment remains the responsibility of a higher-level planner. Existing perceptive controllers train geometry-only encoders from scratch, trading semantics for sim-to-real ease, and typically rely on teacher-student distillation for a task of interest. We present ViBe, a post-training framework for adapting motion trackers to perceptive control tasks. We leverage pre-trained visual encoders with a multi-query extractor module to learn task-relevant perceptive feedback. This feedback is grafted onto the tracker's input via low-rank adapters, enabling parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Given a task reward and a reference dataset, this modular controller can be adapted directly via policy optimization. Across four tasks, ViBe shows zero-shot sim-to-real transfer spanning perceptive walking on curbs and parkour, Repose Cube, omni-object loco-manipulation, and dodgeball, with visually robust performance across outdoor, low-light, and RGB distractor conditions. Finally, we solve a goal-oriented Repose Cube task with a deliberately simple planner, demonstrating the efficacy of perceptive controllers, adapted by our approach.

摘要（中文）：运动追踪为人形全身控制提供了一种可扩展的方案。由于设计特性，生成的追踪器缺乏外部感知反馈，因此对环境的响应仍需由更高层级的规划器负责。现有感知控制器从零开始训练仅依赖几何信息的编码器，以牺牲语义信息来换取仿真到现实的简易性，并通常针对特定任务采用师生蒸馏方法。我们提出ViBe——一个将运动追踪器适配至感知控制任务的后训练框架。通过利用预训练的视觉编码器与多查询提取模块，我们学习与任务相关的感知反馈。该反馈通过低秩适配器嫁接至追踪器输入端，从而实现参数高效的微调。给定任务奖励函数与参考数据集，该模块化控制器可直接通过策略优化进行适配。在四项任务中，ViBe展现了零样本的仿真到现实迁移能力，涵盖路缘与跑酷场景的感知行走、翻转方块、全物体移动操作及躲避球任务，且在户外、弱光及RGB干扰条件下均保持稳健的视觉表现。最终，我们通过一个刻意简化的规划器解决了面向目标的翻转方块任务，验证了经本方法适配的感知控制器的有效性。

Authors: Lokesh Krishna, Sarvesh Venkatesan, An Zhang, Quan Nguyen

GTA-2: A Multi-VLM Framework for Synthesizing Robot Manipulation Skills via Grounded Task Axes Manipulation

multi-VLM framework grounded task axes zero-shot skill generation robot manipulation task decomposition

简要说明：GTA-2是一个模块化的多VLM框架，通过接地任务轴零样本生成定制化的操作技能，在真实机器人任务上达到73.9%的平均成功率，无需任何训练。

TLDR: GTA-2 is a modular multi-VLM framework that generates zero-shot, task-bespoke manipulation skills via grounded task axes, achieving 73.9% average success on real-robot tasks without any training.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks are often decomposed into behaviors or skills. However, one often needs to predefine these behaviors for specific tasks or try to cover a wide range of tasks using generic skills. As a result, these behaviors can remain too coarse to expose the geometric, control, and scene-dependent decisions required for execution. We introduce Grounded Task Axes v2 (GTA-2), a modular multi-VLM framework that constructs executable, task-bespoke manipulation skills from reusable object-centric task-axis components. Rather than predicting actions end-to-end or composing fixed task-level primitives, GTA-2 represents each skill as semantic subtasks comprising task-relevant keypoints and axes, controller compositions, and scene-dependent parameters. Four specialized VLM agents separately decompose the task, construct an abstract task-axis skill, assign controller parameters, and ground the required visual features from RGB-D observations. This abstraction-to-grounding factorization enables zero-shot skill generation without task-specific robot demonstrations, policy training, or fine-tuning. It also keeps intermediate decisions explicit, allowing targeted human feedback to refine an incorrect stage while preserving correct components. We evaluate GTA-2 on 14 real-robot manipulation tasks against a VLA policy pi_{0.5} and two Code-as-Policies baselines using task-axis controllers or conventional robot primitives. GTA-2 achieves an average zero-shot success rate of 73.9%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 31.4 percentage points, while targeted refinement raises GTA-2's average success rate to 90.7%. Project page: https://gta2-project.github.io/

摘要（中文）：机器人操作任务通常被分解为行为或技能。然而，往往需要为特定任务预定义这些行为，或尝试使用通用技能覆盖广泛的任务范围。这导致这些行为可能过于粗粒度，无法体现执行所需的几何、控制及场景依赖决策。我们提出GTA-2（接地任务轴v2），一种模块化多VLM框架，通过可复用的以物体为中心的任务轴组件构建可执行的、任务定制的操作技能。GTA-2并非端到端预测动作或组合固定任务级基元，而是将每个技能表示为包含任务相关关键点与轴、控制器组合以及场景依赖参数的语义子任务。四个专用VLM智能体分别执行任务分解、构建抽象任务轴技能、分配控制器参数，并从RGB-D观测中提取所需视觉特征。这种从抽象到具身化的分解机制实现了零样本技能生成，无需任务特定的机器人演示、策略训练或微调。同时，它保持中间决策的可解释性，允许针对性人工反馈修正错误阶段而保留正确组件。我们在14项真实机器人操作任务上，将GTA-2与VLA策略π₀.₅以及两个使用任务轴控制器或常规机器人基元的Code-as-Policies基线进行对比。GTA-2平均零样本成功率达73.9%，超出最强基线31.4个百分点，而针对性优化将GTA-2平均成功率提升至90.7%。项目页面：https://gta2-project.github.io/

Authors: M. Yunus Seker, Shobhit Aggarwal, Ruwan Wickramarachchi, Jonathan Francis, Oliver Kroemer

A Risk-Sensitive and Uncertainty-Aware Decision-Making and Control Framework for Safe and Robust Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

risk-sensitive distributional RL uncertainty-aware control barrier function autonomous driving decision-making safety correction mechanism unsignalized intersections

简要说明：本文提出了一个用于无信号交叉口自动驾驶的风险敏感与不确定性感知决策控制框架（RUDC），结合分布式强化学习、集成不确定性量化与自适应控制障碍函数，以平衡安全性、效率和鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a risk-sensitive and uncertainty-aware decision-making and control framework (RUDC) for autonomous driving at unsignalized intersections, which combines distributional RL, ensemble-based uncertainty quantification, and an adaptive control barrier function to balance safety, efficiency, and robustness.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated considerable potential for autonomous driving decision-making. However, its deployment in urban autonomous driving, particularly at highly interactive unsignalized intersections, remains challenging, as learned policies may struggle to maintain both safety and robust decision-making in complex traffic situations. Conventional safety-filtering approaches typically employ fixed conservative constraints, which may improve safety at the cost of excessive intervention and degraded traffic efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose a Risk-sensitive and Uncertainty-aware Decision-making and Control (RUDC) framework for safe and robust autonomous driving. RUDC couples risk-sensitive distributional RL with ensemble-based policy uncertainty quantification, jointly accounting for tail risks in return distributions and uncertainty in learned policies. An uncertainty-aware high-order control barrier function (HOCBF)-based safety correction mechanism adaptively adjusts constraint strictness according to policy uncertainty, while a learnable residual predictor compensates for CBF model mismatches and discretization errors. Extensive simulations at unsignalized intersections demonstrate that RUDC achieves a favorable balance among safety, efficiency, and robustness, outperforming representative safe RL baselines under both nominal and challenging OOD and long-tail scenarios while satisfying real-time requirements.

摘要（中文）：强化学习在自动驾驶决策中展现出巨大潜力，但其在城市自动驾驶（尤其是高度交互的无信号交叉口场景）中的部署仍具挑战性——习得策略在复杂交通状况下难以同时保障安全性与稳健决策。传统安全过滤方法通常采用固定保守约束，虽然能提升安全性，却以过度干预和交通效率下降为代价。针对这些局限，我们提出面向安全稳健自动驾驶的风险敏感与不确定性感知决策控制框架（RUDC）。该框架将风险敏感分布强化学习与基于集成的策略不确定性量化相结合，同时考虑回报分布的尾部风险与习得策略的不确定性。基于不确定性感知的高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBF）安全校正机制可根据策略不确定性自适应调整约束严格程度，而可学习残差预测器则用于补偿CBF模型失配与离散化误差。在无信号交叉口的大量仿真实验表明，RUDC在安全性、效率与稳健性之间取得了良好平衡，在常规工况及具有挑战性的分布外与长尾场景下均优于代表性安全强化学习基线，同时满足实时性要求。

Authors: Zhuoren Li, Ran Yu, Weiqi Zhang, Ming Liu, Lu Xiong, Chen Sun, Bo Leng

JEPA Policy: Diffusion-Free Imitation Learning via Paired Action and Future Representation Prediction Manipulation

imitation learning future representation prediction visuomotor policy diffusion-free low-latency

简要说明：本文提出了 JEPA Policy，一种无扩散的模仿学习框架，通过联合预测动作和未来表示，在模拟和真实机器人任务中优于仅动作基线和扩散策略，同时仅增加极小的延迟。

TLDR: This paper introduces JEPA Policy, a diffusion-free imitation learning framework that jointly predicts actions and future representations, improving performance over action-only baselines and Diffusion Policy in simulated and real robot tasks while adding minimal latency.

Abstract: Standard behavior cloning supervises actions without explicitly constraining the future representation paired with each demonstrated action chunk. We introduce JEPA Policy, a diffusion-free framework that uses the action chunk and its observed future representation as paired training targets. Action and future-representation tokens interact in a shared Transformer and are refined through two forward passes. Future prediction can therefore shape the representation used to generate actions. Dual-branch and gradient-routing controls attribute the gain to this shared topology rather than to an auxiliary prediction head alone. Across nine simulated tasks, JEPA Policy improves mean success over the action-only MIP baseline and outperforms Diffusion Policy under the evaluated configurations, while adding 0.29 ms to MIP's model latency. A five-task, 630-episode physical-robot study produces the same pooled ranking. Further audits find no complete representation collapse under action supervision and identify a task-conditioned failure-ranking signal in future-prediction error. These results support paired future-representation supervision as a practical approach to low-latency visuomotor imitation without iterative generative sampling.

摘要（中文）：标准行为克隆在监督动作时，并未显式约束与每个演示动作片段配对的未来表示。本文提出JEPA策略（JEPA Policy），这是一种无扩散框架，将动作片段及其观察到的未来表示作为配对训练目标。动作与未来表示标记在共享Transformer中交互，并通过两次前向传播进行精炼。因此，未来预测能够塑造用于生成动作的表示。双分支与梯度路由控制机制将性能提升归因于这种共享拓扑结构，而非仅凭辅助预测头。在九个模拟任务中，JEPA策略相比仅基于动作的MIP基线提高了平均成功率，并在评估配置下优于扩散策略，同时仅增加MIP模型0.29毫秒的延迟。一项包含五个任务、630个回合的实体机器人研究得出了相同的综合排名。进一步审计发现，在动作监督下未出现完整的表示坍塌，并在未来预测误差中识别出任务条件化的失败排名信号。这些结果表明，配对未来表示监督是一种无需迭代生成采样的低延迟视觉运动模仿实用方法。

Authors: Jie Xu, Kangjin Yu, Ziyi Jin, Junjie Gao, Liqing Chen, Yixian Li, Shuai Tian, Zhongpu Xia

Actuator Dynamics Curricula for Narrow-Viability Tasks in Legged Robot Learning Locomotion

actuator dynamics curriculum narrow-viability tasks legged robot learning reinforcement learning sim-to-real

简要说明：该论文提出了一种执行器动力学课程，在训练过程中退火关节刚度以扩大窄可行性任务的可行性核，在cart-pole系统和波士顿动力Spot的四足到倒立过渡中得到了验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes an Actuator Dynamics Curriculum that anneals joint stiffness during training to expand the viability kernel for narrow-viability tasks in legged robot learning, demonstrated on a cart-pole system and a quadrupedal-to-handstand transition on the Boston Dynamics Spot hardware.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has produced capable controllers across a broad range of legged-robot tasks, but a subset of these tasks fail to converge under standard training: those for which most exploration trajectories terminate before producing useful gradient signal. To address such tasks we introduce the \emph{Actuator Dynamics Curriculum}, a procedure that initializes joint stiffness at a high value and anneals it toward the system-identified value as completed episode lengths grow. Using a cart-pole system as a representative example, we show that higher closed-loop joint natural frequency under critical damping enlarges the viability kernel of the underlying Markov Decision Process, increasing the fraction of initial states from which the task is feasible. We validate the kernel monotonicity on the cart-pole and apply the curriculum to a quadrupedal-to-handstand transition on the Boston Dynamics Spot, a narrow-viability task where training under fixed identified stiffness plateaus at a policy that never completes the transition. The trained policy executes the transition in simulation across 10 seeds and transfers to hardware. More broadly, our results suggest that simulated actuator dynamics is a useful axis along which to design curricula for tasks in which exploration is bottlenecked by termination conditions rather than by reward signal.

摘要（中文）：强化学习已经在广泛的腿式机器人任务中产生了具备控制能力的控制器，但其中部分任务在标准训练下难以收敛：这类任务中，大多数探索轨迹在产生有用的梯度信号之前便提前终止。为解决此类任务，我们引入了**执行器动力学课程**：该过程将关节刚度初始化为较高值，并随着完成的回合步长增长，逐步将其退火至系统辨识值。以推车-倒立摆系统作为代表性示例，我们证明了在临界阻尼条件下，更高的闭环关节固有频率会扩大底层马尔可夫决策过程的可行域，从而增加任务可行的初始状态比例。我们通过推车-倒立摆系统验证了可行域的单调性，并将该课程应用于波士顿动力Spot机器人的四足转倒立过渡任务——这是一项窄可行域任务，在固定辨识刚度下的标准训练会因策略无法完成过渡而陷入停滞。经过训练的策略在10个随机种子的仿真中成功执行了过渡，并迁移至硬件。更广泛地，我们的结果表明：对于探索受终止条件（而非奖励信号）瓶颈限制的任务，模拟执行器动力学是设计课程的一个有效维度。

Authors: Kousheek Chakraborty, Chandan K. Rajendra, Ayham Alharbat, Abeje Y. Mersha

Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization WorldModel

world model latent dynamics zero-shot generalization physics generalization robotic control

简要说明：SG-JEPA通过动作条件动力学和多步展开损失扩展了潜在世界模型，实现了对未见物理环境（如不同重力）的零样本泛化，并在模拟机器人任务中提升了预测和控制性能。

TLDR: SG-JEPA extends latent world models with action-conditioned dynamics and multi-step rollout loss, achieving zero-shot generalization to unseen physics (e.g., different gravity) and improving both prediction and control in simulated robotic tasks.

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models learn a compact latent representation of the world that supports prediction and planning, but their capability to learn physics and generate physically realistic dynamics remains hitherto untested. In this work, we introduce SemiGroup-JEPA (SG-JEPA), which extends the LeWorldModel framework by supplying the parameter governing the physics to the temporal model via action-conditioning and jointly training an encoder and predictor through an autoregressive latent rollout. To evaluate the model's ability to generalize out of distribution, we design dynamical tasks under different gravitational fields that, despite obeying the same physical law, exhibit qualitatively different dynamics, ranging from floating motion in weak gravitational fields to rapid bouncing in strong ones. In contrast to DINO-WM, SG-JEPA reduces open-loop prediction error by up to 2 times on two-dimensional datasets, and increases control success rate up to 2.5 times for three-dimensional robotic datasets, for which we train independent diffusion policies. To explain this advantage, we develop a linear feature model that separates local law-conditioned error from its recursive amplification under rollout. Guided by this model, we find that back-propagating the multi-step rollout loss into the representation trains the encoder to keep the features that the predictor can carry forward, and that those are the features the dynamics depend on, so most of the gain comes from the encoder learning better features rather than from the predictor learning better dynamics. See project page at https://sg-jepa.github.io.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型通过学习世界的紧致潜在表征来支持预测与规划，但其学习物理规律并生成符合物理现实动态过程的能力至今尚未得到验证。本文提出半群组JEPA（SG-JEPA），它扩展了LeWorldModel框架，通过动作条件化将控制物理过程的参数传递给时序模型，并利用自回归潜变量展开联合训练编码器与预测器。为评估模型在分布外场景的泛化能力，我们设计了不同引力场下的动力学任务——这些任务虽遵循相同物理定律，却展现出从弱引力场中的漂浮运动到强引力场中的快速弹跳等性质迥异的动力学行为。与DINO-WM相比，SG-JEPA在二维数据集上的开环预测误差降低至原来的2倍，在三维机器人数据集上的控制成功率提升至2.5倍（我们为后者训练了独立扩散策略）。为解释这一优势，我们构建了线性特征模型，将局部的物理条件相关误差与其在展开过程中的递归放大效应分离开来。基于该模型指引，我们发现将多步展开损失反向传播至表征层，能训练编码器保留预测器可向前传递的特征——而这些正是动力学所依赖的关键特征。因此，性能提升主要源于编码器学到更优质的特征，而非预测器学到更优的动力学模型。项目主页详见https://sg-jepa.github.io。

Authors: Andy Zeyi Liu, Haoran Sun, Lucas Baker, Randall Balestriero, John Sous

A Confidence-Aware Multimodal Fusion Framework for Industrial Human-Robot Collaboration Manipulation

human-robot collaboration multimodal fusion intention prediction BiLSTM confidence-aware

简要说明：本文提出一种置信度感知的多模态融合框架 (CAMF)，融合物体6D位姿、注视、骨骼运动和IMU手部运动来预测工业人机协作中的人类意图，在UR3机器人平台上达到91.86%的准确率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a confidence-aware multimodal fusion framework (CAMF) that integrates object 6D pose, gaze, skeletal motion, and IMU hand motion to predict human intention in industrial human-robot collaboration, achieving 91.86% accuracy on a UR3 robot platform.

Abstract: A confidence-aware multimodal fusion framework (CAMF) is proposed to realize reliable human intention prediction for industrial human-robot collaboration. This framework fuses four heterogeneous modalities including object 6D pose, gaze, skeletal motion and IMU-based hand motion. It embeds a confidence-trend-driven dynamic fusion mechanism into BiLSTM to adaptively balance bidirectional temporal features according to real-time modality reliability. A confidence-guided balanced learning strategy combined with a confidence freezing mechanism is further adopted to adjust network gradients dynamically, suppress noise from low-quality modalities and mitigate cross-modal learning bias. A physical platform based on the UR3 collaborative robot is built for experimental validation. Comparative results show that the proposed method reaches an intention recognition accuracy of 91.86% and outperforms existing multimodal fusion approaches in overall performance and stability. It also maintains satisfactory accuracy under low light and partial occlusion interference. In practical assembly tasks, the framework enables proactive and stable human-robot cooperation with strong environmental adaptability.

摘要（中文）：一种面向工业人机协作的置信度感知多模态融合框架（CAMF）被提出，以实现可靠的人类意图预测。该框架融合了四种异质模态，包括物体6D位姿、注视方向、骨骼运动及基于IMU的手部运动。它通过将置信度趋势驱动的动态融合机制嵌入双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM），根据实时模态可靠性自适应平衡双向时序特征。进一步采用置信度引导的平衡学习策略与置信度冻结机制，动态调整网络梯度，抑制低质量模态的噪声并缓解跨模态学习偏差。基于UR3协作机器人搭建物理平台进行实验验证。对比结果表明，所提方法意图识别准确率达91.86%，在整体性能与稳定性上优于现有模态融合方法，且在弱光与部分遮挡干扰下仍保持良好准确率。在实际装配任务中，该框架实现了主动且稳定的人机协作，具备强环境适应性。

Odometer-Agnostic Drift Correction Using OpenStreetMap Lane Geometry AutonomousDriving

简要说明：一种轻量级、与里程计无关的漂移校正方法，通过将短轨迹段与OpenStreetMap车道中心线对齐，在严重漂移下对激光雷达和视觉里程计实现持续改进。

TLDR: A lightweight, odometry-agnostic drift correction method that aligns short trajectory segments to OpenStreetMap lane centerlines, achieving consistent improvements for LiDAR and visual odometry under severe drift.

Abstract: Despite significant progress in odometry estimation, long-term drift remains a fundamental limitation of incremental pose integration, especially in large-scale or loop-free environments. Existing map-assisted methods can reduce drift, but often depend on dense maps, sensor-specific processing, or complex matching pipelines. We propose a lightweight open-source, odometry-agnostic correction method that aligns short trajectory segments to OpenStreetMap (OSM) lane centerlines. By formulating drift correction as a direct alignment between recent odometry and sparse lane geometry, the method enables efficient online operation without dense priors or expensive preprocessing. Experiments with LiDAR and visual odometry backends demonstrate consistent improvements, with particularly strong gains under severe drift.

摘要（中文）：尽管里程估计技术取得了显著进展，但长期漂移仍是增量式位姿融合的根本性局限，尤其在大型或无闭环环境中表现突出。现有地图辅助方法虽能减少漂移，但往往依赖稠密地图、特定传感器处理或复杂匹配流程。本文提出一种轻量级开源、与里程计无关的校正方法，通过将短时轨迹段与OpenStreetMap（OSM）车道中心线对齐实现漂移修正。该方法将漂移校正问题转化为近期里程计与稀疏车道几何之间的直接对齐，无需稠密先验或昂贵预处理即可实现高效在线运行。基于激光雷达和视觉里程计后端的实验表明，该方法能够持续提升性能，在严重漂移场景中效果尤为显著。

Authors: Joaquin Caballero, Emilio Garcia-Fidalgo, Alberto Ortiz, Jarno Ralli

What Symmetry Buys a Learned Motion Planner RLRobot

motion planning equivariance frame transformation learned planner collision-free rate

简要说明：本文表明，在起始和目标状态确定的坐标系中表达运动规划查询（消除SE(3)的5个自由度），能显著提升学习型规划器的性能，其效果超过了显式的等变性机制。

TLDR: This paper shows that expressing motion planning queries in a frame fixed by the start and goal states (removing 5 of 6 SE(3) degrees of freedom) dramatically improves learned planner performance, dominating explicit equivariance mechanisms.

Abstract: Learning-based motion planners pay at training what classical planners pay per query. Trained in world coordinates, they relearn the same motion at every position and orientation. Existing work restores the missing rigid-body equivariance in the training data, in the inference operator, or in the weights, and each carries a cost. We ask how much of that equivariance the planning query supplies for free. A start s and a goal g determine a frame in closed form, with origin at their midpoint and first axis along g-s. Expressing trajectory and obstacles in that frame removes three translations and two rotations of SE(3), at initialisation, for one cross product per query and with no constraint on the architecture. A single rotation about the start-goal axis remains, and no continuous rule removes it. On a cluttered 3D benchmark, holding architecture, data and budget fixed, the frame raises the held-out collision-free rate from 14.60% to 51.10%, where a straight segment from start to goal scores 15.6% and the world-frame model does not beat it. We build all three mechanisms for the residual rotation and each is worth under a point, though the equivariant backbone reaches any given level two to three times sooner. What the representation supplies therefore dominates what any mechanism enforces, and the standard diagnostic does not see the difference: two models with indistinguishable non-equivariance residuals differ by 28 points. Calibrated against a non-symmetry intervention, the frame is not even the largest effect available, since local geometry is worth +40.0 where the frame is worth +36.5.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的运动规划器在训练阶段付出的代价，相当于传统规划器每次查询所付出的代价。由于在世界坐标系中训练，它们需要在每个位置和方向重新学习相同的运动。现有工作通过训练数据、推理算子或网络权重恢复了缺失的刚体等变性，但每种方法都有其代价。我们探究规划查询本身能无偿提供多少等变性。 起点s与终点g以闭式解确定一个参考系：原点位于二者中点，第一轴沿g-s方向。在该参考系中表达轨迹与障碍物，可在初始化时消除SE(3)的三个平移自由度和两个旋转自由度，每次查询仅需一次叉积运算，且对网络架构无任何约束。仅剩绕起点-终点轴的一个旋转自由度，而没有任何连续规则能消除它。在杂乱三维基准测试中，保持架构、数据和预算固定，该参考系将未见场景的无碰撞率从14.60%提升至51.10%，而起点到终点的直线段得分为15.6%，世界坐标系模型甚至未能超越该基线。我们为剩余旋转构建了全部三种机制，每种机制贡献值均不足一个百分点——尽管等变骨干网络达到任意指定水平的速度要快两到三倍。由此可见，表征本身提供的等变性远胜于任何机制强制施加的效果，而标准诊断方法无法识别这一差异：两个非等变性残差难以区分的模型，实际得分相差28个百分点。与非对称干预校准后的结果相比，参考系甚至并非可用的最大增益来源——局部几何特征贡献值为+40.0，而参考系贡献值为+36.5。

Authors: Andrea Emir Sevincel

CLFTv2: Efficient Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Semantic Segmentation via Hierarchical Feature Pyramids AutonomousDriving

camera-LiDAR fusion semantic segmentation autonomous driving hierarchical feature pyramid real-time perception

简要说明：CLFTv2是一种用于自动驾驶语义分割的高效相机-激光雷达融合框架，采用分层Swin编码器和轻量级解码器，在提高VRU召回率和吞吐量方面优于全局注意力方法。

TLDR: CLFTv2 is an efficient camera-LiDAR fusion framework for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving, using a hierarchical Swin-based encoder and lightweight decoder to improve VRU recall and throughput over global-attention methods.

Abstract: Semantic segmentation for autonomous driving requires reliable detection of vulnerable road users (VRUs) despite heavy class imbalance. We introduce CLFTv2, a hierarchical camera-LiDAR fusion framework replacing global ViT attention with a Swin-based multi-scale encoder and a lightweight FPN-style residual decoder. Operating in the 2D perspective domain, CLFTv2 integrates multi-scale geometric cues through shifted-window attention and per-scale residual fusion, avoiding the computational overhead of query-matching decoders. Across three driving datasets, CLFTv2 consistently improves VRU recall. On ZOD, CLFTv2-Large achieves 53.5\% mIoU, improving pedestrian IoU from 35.5\% to 44.9\% over the prior CLFT model. On Waymo, CLFTv2 reaches 61.7\% mIoU. Additionally, a modality-isolation study suggests ViT's global receptive field yields stronger fusion gains only under dense LiDAR returns. Compared to a Swin-based Mask2Former adaptation, CLFTv2 requires 1.4$\times$ fewer GFLOPs and delivers 2.2$\times$ higher throughput, while achieving comparable overall accuracy. These results demonstrate that hierarchical local-attention fusion offers an efficient, scalable alternative to global-attention and query-based decoders for real-time on-vehicle perception in intelligent transportation systems. Source code is publicly available.

摘要（中文）：面向自动驾驶的语义分割需要在严重类别不平衡的情况下，可靠地检测弱势道路使用者（VRU）。我们提出CLFTv2，一种分层式相机-激光雷达融合框架，用基于Swin的多尺度编码器和轻量级FPN风格残差解码器替代了全局ViT注意力机制。在二维透视域中运行时，CLFTv2通过移位窗口注意力和逐尺度残差融合整合多尺度几何线索，避免了查询匹配解码器的计算开销。在三个驾驶数据集上，CLFTv2持续提升了VRU召回率。在ZOD数据集上，CLFTv2-Large达到了53.5%的mIoU，将行人IoU从先前CLFT模型的35.5%提升至44.9%。在Waymo数据集上，CLFTv2达到了61.7%的mIoU。此外，模态隔离研究表明，仅当激光雷达点云密度较高时，ViT的全局感受野才能产生更强的融合增益。与基于Swin的Mask2Former改进版相比，CLFTv2的GFLOPs减少了1.4倍，吞吐量提升了2.2倍，同时实现了相当的整体精度。这些结果表明，对于智能交通系统中的实时车载感知，分层式局部注意力融合为全局注意力和基于查询的解码器提供了一种高效、可扩展的替代方案。源代码已公开。

Authors: Toomas Tahves, Mauro Bellone, Raivo Sell

PccDiffuser: Multi-solution Motion Planning for Continuum Robots Manipulation

diffusion model continuum robot motion planning obstacle avoidance piecewise constant-curvature model

简要说明：PccDiffuser 采用条件扩散模型为连续体机器人生成多条无碰撞位形空间路径，结合图神经网络障碍物编码与解析微分运动学，实现了高成功率和计算效率。

TLDR: PccDiffuser uses a conditional diffusion model to generate multiple collision-free configuration-space paths for continuum robots, integrating GNN-based obstacle encoding and analytical differential kinematics for high success rate and efficiency.

Abstract: We present the PccDiffuser, a conditional diffusion framework for continuum robots that learns a multimodal distribution over complete configuration-space paths and samples multiple candidate solutions in parallel, which are subsequently converted into an executable trajectory by time allocation considering actuator constraints. Under the piecewise constant-curvature model, we use exponential co-ordinates to describe the robot kinematics, and use graph neural network to encode a variable number of environment obstacles. Analytical differential kinematics is incorporated in the denoising process to improve terminal accuracy and whole-body clearance. On a mixed test set comprising workspace with zero to four obstacles, PccDiffuser achieved a success rate of 91\%. Compared with existing sampling- and optimisation-based benchmarks, it delivered both a higher success rate and greater computational efficiency, with the latter advantage becoming more substantial when sampling more candidate solutions. Experiments on a three-section tendon-driven continuum robot further demonstrate consecutive planning, multi-solution planning, and whole-body obstacle avoidance.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了PccDiffuser，这是一种针对连续体机器人的条件扩散框架，能够学习完整配置空间路径上的多模态分布，并并行采样多个候选解，随后通过考虑执行器约束的时间分配将其转换为可执行轨迹。在分段常曲率模型下，我们使用指数坐标描述机器人运动学，并利用图神经网络对数量可变的障碍物进行编码。在去噪过程中融入解析微分运动学，以提高末端精度和全身避障能力。在包含零至四个障碍物的混合测试集上，PccDiffuser实现了91%的成功率。与现有的基于采样和优化的基准方法相比，它不仅成功率更高，计算效率也更优，且当采样更多候选解时，后一优势更为显著。在三段绳驱连续体机器人上的实验进一步展示了连续规划、多解规划以及全身避障能力。

Authors: Ke Qiu, Sifan Chen, Si Wang, Rong Xiong, Yue Wang, Haojian Lu

Compact Visuotactile World Models for Lifting: Prediction, Reward Alignment, and Force Constraints Manipulation

visuotactile world model force-constrained control model-assisted feedback behavior cloning reactive implicit Q-learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种紧凑的视觉触觉世界模型用于仿真中的刚性箱子抬升任务，表明触觉预测改善了力约束控制，模型辅助反馈提升了任务成功率，但未进行物理机器人迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents a compact visuotactile world model for rigid-box lifting in simulation, showing that tactile prediction improves force-constrained control and model-assisted feedback boosts task success, though without physical robot transfer.

Abstract: Accurate tactile forecasts need not improve force-constrained control. We study a 652,157-parameter action-conditioned visuotactile world model with matched behavior cloning, policy learning in imagination, independent reactive implicit Q-learning, and model-assisted force feedback. A fixed protocol executes 34 policies on 120 fresh MuJoCo environments spanning geometry and physical-parameter shifts, plus 324 independently replayed action branches on 12 additional ID environments. Visuotactile dynamics reduce force action-effect MAE from 0.413 N for persistence to 0.338 N. Model-assisted feedback raises ID force-budgeted success from 73.3% to 93.3%, with paired difference +20.0 [+6.7,+33.4] percentage points (95% CI), with the difference occurring during scripted lowering. Its pooled difference is +3.9 [-4.5,+11.7] points. Imagined RL achieves 11.9% pooled joint success versus 25.0% for reactive IQL. An empirical tactile-residual stress test adds 330 executions. The evidence concerns rigid-box lifting after a common approach, without physical-robot transfer or a closed-loop safety guarantee.

摘要（中文）：精确的触觉预测未必能改进力约束控制。我们研究了一个包含652,157个参数的、基于动作条件的视觉触觉世界模型，该模型结合了行为克隆、想象策略学习、独立反应式隐式Q学习及模型辅助力反馈。固定协议在120个涵盖几何与物理参数变化的新MuJoCo环境中执行34种策略，并在12个额外ID环境中对324个独立重放的动作分支进行测试。视觉触觉动力学将力作用效应的平均绝对误差（MAE）从持久性模型的0.413 N降至0.338 N。模型辅助反馈使ID环境下的力预算成功率从73.3%提升至93.3%，配对差异为+20.0 [+6.7,+33.4]个百分点（95%置信区间），该差异出现在程序化下降阶段。其合并差异为+3.9 [-4.5,+11.7]个百分点。想象强化学习（RL）的合并联合成功率为11.9%，而反应式IQL为25.0%。一项经验性触觉残余应力测试增加了330次执行。相关证据针对的是通用接近方式后的刚性箱体提升任务，未涉及物理机器人迁移或闭环安全保障。

Authors: Qinzhen Ma

Modality-Decoupled Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Embodied Intelligence in 6G VLA

modality-decoupled federated learning privacy-preserving embodied intelligence vision-language-action models 6G wireless networks robotic manipulation federated

简要说明：本文提出FedMVLA，一种面向6G网络中隐私保护具身智能的模态解耦联邦学习框架，通过分别处理视觉、语言和动作模态，提升分布式机器人操作中的通信效率、隐私保护和任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes FedMVLA, a modality-decoupled federated learning framework for privacy-preserving embodied intelligence in 6G networks, which separately handles vision, language, and action modalities to improve communication efficiency, privacy, and task success rate in distributed robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks are expected to provide a key infrastructure for large-scale embodied intelligence, where heterogeneous robots collaborate through low-latency connectivity, edge intelligence, and distributed sensing. Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a foundation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation into a unified closed-loop policy. However, training and adapting VLA models to distributed robotic agents introduce challenges in privacy protection, communication efficiency, and model heterogeneity. Existing federated learning (FL) methods overlook the intrinsic differences among vision, language, and action pathways in parameter scale, privacy exposure, update dynamics, and tolerance to compression or perturbation. To address this issue, this article proposes FedMVLA, a modality-decoupled FL framework for privacy-preserving embodied intelligence in 6G networks. FedMVLA incorporates three mechanisms: modality-aware federated aggregation (MAFA), modality-aware privacy allocation (MAPA), and modality-aware communication compression (MACO), together with a modality-sliced transport design that routes the precision-critical action stream through a protected ultra-reliable low-latency slice. A case study on federated robotic manipulation over the Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP)-based wireless substrate, covering fading, co-channel interference, and malicious jamming, shows that FedMVLA achieves an 84.8% task success rate, exceeds FedAvg by 22.2 percentage points, sustains a widening margin when scaling to 128 clients across eight cells, and reduces the schedule-averaged per-client uplink model-update payload by 95.6% (approximately 96%), while keeping the 95th percentile (p95) of the round-critical uplink completion time near 1.5s.

摘要（中文）：第六代（6G）无线网络有望为大规模具身智能提供关键基础设施，异构机器人通过低时延连接、边缘智能与分布式感知实现协同工作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成整合为统一闭环策略奠定了技术基础。然而，将VLA模型训练并适配至分布式机器人智能体时，面临隐私保护、通信效率及模型异构性方面的挑战。现有联邦学习（FL）方法忽略了视觉、语言与动作通路在参数规模、隐私暴露、更新动态及对压缩/扰动容忍度方面的本质差异。为此，本文提出FedMVLA——一种面向6G网络隐私保护具身智能的模态解耦联邦学习框架。该框架包含三种机制：模态感知联邦聚合（MAFA）、模态感知隐私分配（MAPA）及模态感知通信压缩（MACO），并结合模态分片传输设计，将精度关键的动作流路由至受保护的超可靠低时延切片。基于第三代合作伙伴计划（3GPP）无线网络环境（涵盖衰落、同信道干扰与恶意干扰）的联邦机器人操作案例研究表明：FedMVLA的任务成功率达84.8%，较FedAvg提升22.2个百分点；当扩展至八个小区128个客户端时性能优势持续扩大；其调度平均单客户端上行模型更新负载降低95.6%（约96%），同时将轮次关键上行完成时间的第95百分位数（p95）维持在1.5秒附近。

Authors: Zhuodong Liu, Xiangyu Li, Chunhong Yuan, Hongyang Du, Bodong Shang, Qingqing Wu, Tony Q. S. Quek, Mohsen Guizani

Valerant: An Automatic Navigable Game Map Generator via Action-Conditioned World Model Exploration WorldModel

action-conditioned world model World Action Model SLAM-based spatial reconstruction 3D game map generation exploration-driven action selection

简要说明：Valerant 是一个无需训练框架，将预训练的动作条件世界模型转化为世界动作模型，通过 SLAM 空间重建和探索驱动的动作选择，从单张图像逐步构建持久的 3D 游戏地图。

TLDR: Valerant is a training-free framework that turns a pretrained action-conditioned world model into a World Action Model for exploring and constructing persistent 3D game maps from a single image, using SLAM-based spatial reconstruction and exploration-driven action selection.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive world modeling with action generation, allowing anticipated future states to guide agent behavior. Although WAMs are rapidly advancing embodied AI, general-purpose counterparts remain largely unexplored in games. Existing game-oriented approaches often combine action-conditioned world models with external policies and reward functions to realize WAM-like decision-making, yet they operate mainly in 2D visual observation space and do not instantiate persistent 3D geometry. Extending this paradigm to 3D games introduces a distinct challenge. In autonomous driving and robotics, the physical environment exists independently of the model, providing a persistent 3D world in which selected actions can be executed. Games have no such external substrate; the virtual world itself must be instantiated. Most playable games require a persistent and navigable space, while 3D games additionally require explicit geometry that supports movement and interaction. Action-conditioned video rollouts provide visual observations but not this spatial representation. We present \textsc{Valerant}, a training-free framework that transforms a pretrained action-conditioned world model into a WAM for exploring and constructing 3D game maps. By coupling predictive visual rollouts with SLAM-based spatial reconstruction and exploration-driven action selection, \textsc{Valerant} progressively transforms a single image into a persistent 3D game map. This framework extends WAM-based interaction beyond 2D visual simulation and offers a new approach to reducing manual effort in 3D game-map creation.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）将预测性世界建模与动作生成相结合，使预期的未来状态能够引导智能体行为。尽管WAMs正快速推动具身人工智能的发展，但其通用型模型在游戏领域仍鲜有探索。现有面向游戏的方法通常将动作条件世界模型与外部策略及奖励函数相结合，以近似实现WAM的决策能力，然而这些方法主要运作于二维视觉观测空间，并未实例化持久的三维几何结构。将这一范式拓展至三维游戏面临独特挑战：在自动驾驶与机器人领域，物理环境独立于模型存在，提供了可执行选定动作的持久三维世界；而游戏缺乏此类外部基质——虚拟世界本身必须被实例化。多数可交互游戏需要持久化且可导航的空间，三维游戏则额外要求具备支撑移动与交互的显式几何结构。动作条件视频推演虽能提供视觉观测，却无法生成这种空间表征。我们提出\textsc{Valerant}——一种免训练框架，可将预训练的动作条件世界模型转化为用于探索与构建三维游戏地图的WAM。通过将预测性视觉推演与基于SLAM的空间重建及探索驱动型动作选择相结合，\textsc{Valerant}能够渐进地将单张图像转化为持久的三维游戏地图。该框架将基于WAM的交互从二维视觉模拟中拓展出来，并为减少三维游戏地图创建中的人工工作量提供了新途径。

Authors: Yiran Qiao, Feng Wang, Jing Ma

Programmable World Model WorldModel

programmable world model decoupled state evolution state-augmented 3D OBB interactive video generation CombatStateBench

简要说明：本文提出了一个将显式、持久的世界状态管理与视觉生成解耦的框架，通过自然语言编程的规则和状态增强的3D方向边界框作为中间表示，实现可控、长程的交互式视频生成。

TLDR: This paper introduces a framework that decouples explicit, persistent world-state management from visual generation in video world models, using natural-language-programmed rules and state-augmented 3D OBBs as intermediate representations to enable controllable, long-horizon interactive video generation.

Abstract: Recent video world models generate increasingly realistic and interactive visual experiences, yet lack reliable mechanisms for maintaining persistent world state and enforcing programmable rules over extended interactions. We introduce Programmable World Model, a framework that decouples world-state evolution from visual observation generation. An agent translates natural-language instructions into executable programs that specify entity states and state-transition rules, enabling direct control over individual entities and their interactions. A lightweight engine executes these programs to update and maintain an explicit, persistent global world state, including off-screen entities and non-visual attributes. To connect world state with visual generation, we introduce state-augmented 3D oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) as an intermediate representation. This representation, together with the target camera trajectory, is deterministically compiled into pixel-aligned spatiotemporal conditioning signals for a pretrained video model serving as the generative renderer. This design allows users to create playable games with predefined mechanics, direct control over individual entities, and persistent world state throughout gameplay. We further introduce CombatStateBench, a benchmark for evaluating programmable world models. On CombatStateBench, our method achieves 94% Count Accuracy and 98% State Accuracy, substantially outperforming existing interactive video world models while supporting coherent long-horizon generation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of separating explicit state evolution from generative rendering for building persistent, programmable worlds.

摘要（中文）：最近的视频世界模型生成了越来越真实且可交互的视觉体验，但缺乏可靠机制来维持持久的世界状态，并在长时间交互中执行可编程规则。我们提出了可编程世界模型，该框架将世界状态演化与视觉观察生成解耦。智能体将自然语言指令转化为可执行程序，这些程序指定了实体状态和状态转换规则，从而实现对个体实体及其交互的直接控制。一个轻量级引擎执行这些程序，以更新并维护一个显式、持久的全局世界状态，包括屏幕外实体和非视觉属性。为了将世界状态与视觉生成相连接，我们引入了状态增强的三维有向包围盒作为中间表示。该表示与目标相机轨迹一起，被确定性地编译为像素对齐的时空条件信号，供作为生成渲染器的预训练视频模型使用。这一设计使用户能够创建具有预定义机制、对个体实体的直接控制以及游戏过程中持久世界状态的可玩游戏。我们进一步引入了CombatStateBench基准，用于评估可编程世界模型。在CombatStateBench上，我们的方法实现了94%的计数准确率和98%的状态准确率，显著优于现有的交互式视频世界模型，同时支持连贯的长时程生成。这些结果表明，将显式状态演化与生成式渲染分离，对于构建持久、可编程的世界是有效的。

Authors: Zheng-Hui Huang, Guixu Lin, Jiacheng Lin, Yi-Chuan Huang, Ruihan Yu, Muyao Niu, Siqi Yang, Yu-Lun Liu, Yung-Yu Chuang, Kaipeng Zhang, Zhixiang Wang

MotionBlind: Probing the Illusion of Motion Understanding in Video-LLMs WorldModel

MotionBlind Video-LLMs world model motion understanding contrastive benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了MotionBlind基准，用于评估视频大模型能否感知基本运动属性（速度、大小、方向），发现即使是前沿模型也大多失败，仅Gemini 3.1 Pro超过随机水平。论文认为此类模型当前不足以作为世界模型的可靠感知前端。

TLDR: This paper introduces MotionBlind, a benchmark to evaluate whether Video-LLMs can perceive basic motion properties (speed, magnitude, direction), and finds that even frontier models largely fail, with only Gemini 3.1 Pro exceeding chance. It argues that such models are currently unreliable as perceptual frontends for world models.

Abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) are increasingly used as the perceptual front end of world models, a role that assumes they can read motion: how fast something moves, which way it travels, how hard it is pushed. We show they cannot. A Video-LLM can watch two clips of the same person in the same room, name every object in both, and still fail to say which clip moves faster. We introduce MotionBlind, a contrastive benchmark of self-recorded video for physically grounded motion(speed, magnitude, and direction), the variables a world model must predict. Each instance is a pair of near-identical clips that differ only in motion. Each clip carries two complementary yes/no questions, giving four items per instance, and a model earns credit only if all four are correct. We report Instance Accuracy(IAcc), which has a 6.25% chance floor. Single-frame, appearance, and language-only shortcuts all collapse to it. MotionBlind complements the recent TimeBlind benchmark. We run a controlled study of six open and two frontier Video-LLMs, varying whether the video is present, whether frames are shown in the correct temporal order, and how frames are sampled (1 to 24 frames, four selection strategies). Open models sit near the 6.25% floor, and scale does not help. Removing the video drops every model to zero IAcc, and shuffling frames collapses IAcc to chance, so the task genuinely needs video in order. Neither more frames nor smarter frame selection closes the gap, because these change which frames are seen, not whether motion is read. Only Gemini3.1 Pro clears the benchmark overall, and even it fails on speed. A frontend that cannot tell two speeds of the same action apart is not yet a trustworthy source of supervision, reward, or evaluation for a world model.

摘要（中文）：视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）正日益被用作世界模型的感知前端，这一角色要求它们能够读取运动：物体移动的速度、方向以及被推动的力度。我们的研究表明它们无法做到这一点。一个视频大语言模型可以观看同一人在同一房间的两段视频片段，识别出两段视频中的每个物体，却仍然无法判断哪段视频中物体移动速度更快。我们提出了MotionBlind基准，这是一个基于自录视频的对比测试集，用于评估物理层面上的运动（速度、幅度和方向）感知能力——这些正是世界模型必须预测的变量。每个测试实例由一对近乎相同的视频片段组成，两者仅在运动特征上存在差异。每个片段附带两个互补的“是/否”问题，每个实例共生成四个测试项，模型必须全部答对才能得分。我们报告实例准确率（IAcc），其随机基线为6.25%。基于单帧、外观或纯语言的捷径策略均会退化至此基线。MotionBlind与近期提出的TimeBlind基准形成互补。我们对六个开源和两个前沿的视频大语言模型进行了受控研究，变量包括：是否提供视频、帧序列是否按正确时间顺序排列，以及帧采样方式（1至24帧，四种采样策略）。开源模型的性能接近6.25%的随机基线，且模型规模扩大并无帮助。移除视频后所有模型IAcc降至零，打乱帧顺序后IAcc跌至随机水平，因此该任务确实需要按序观看视频。增加帧数或采用更智能的帧选择策略均无法弥补差距——因为这些操作改变的是“看到哪些帧”，而非“是否读取运动”。只有Gemini3.1 Pro整体通过了基准测试，但即便如此它在速度感知任务上仍表现失败。一个无法区分同一动作中两种速度差异的前端系统，尚不能成为世界模型可靠的监督、奖励或评估来源。

Abstract: This study develops a deep reinforcement learning framework for training Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) agents to navigate and monitor simulated wildfire environments. Results show that agents learn increasingly stable and effective behaviors over time, as demonstrated by converging loss trends, improved reward signals, and more consistent navigation patterns such as fire-boundary tracking. Overall, these findings highlight the potential of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based UAV systems for autonomous wildfire monitoring and suggest that environmental structure and reward design influence policy effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：本研究开发了一个深度强化学习框架，用于训练无人机智能体在模拟野火环境中执行导航与监测任务。结果表明，随着时间推移，智能体能够学习到日益稳定且有效的行动策略，具体表现为损失函数收敛趋势、奖励信号提升以及更稳定的导航模式（如火势边界追踪）。总体而言，这些发现揭示了基于深度强化学习的无人机系统在自主野火监测领域的应用潜力，同时表明环境结构与奖励设计对策略有效性具有重要影响。
